summary: Explains loop_control label (2.2+) to limit console output to a chosen field when looping over complex items; it's for readability, not security, so use no_log for sensitive data.
questions: How do I make loop output less verbose?
How do I show only the item name in loop output?
Does label hide sensitive data in loops?

answer_card.title: Limiting loop output with label
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
loop_control:
  label: "{{ item.name }}"
```

Only `item.name` is shown instead of the whole item. This is for readability only; use `no_log: true` to hide sensitive data.
